_doc: Exploded-view variant of steering-wheel.json for /projects/steering-wheel (chapter 01, the stack-up). Same tessellation and materials; parts are joined per group (not just per material) and each group node carries its explode offset. groups: [regex, id, axial_mm (+ = towards the driver, along the base-plate normal), lateral_mm (+ = driver's right), side? (+ or -: only parts whose centre is on that side)]. Fasteners travel with the part their head sits on; nuts with their bolts. The unnamed 2026-01-12-* parts are the electrical team's board (0.7 mm sheet, 110 x 64 mm) and its connectors, sandwiched between the two standoffs.
